project_info.theme: Hybrid regenerative braking and energy optimization
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, Cyan Glow, Red, White, Asphalt Gray, Yellow

main_subject.detail: A red Toyota Corolla Cross drives over yellow-and-black speed bumps on a city road, with glowing cyan highlights around the wheels to symbolize regenerative braking energy capture.
main_subject.style: Photoreal hybrid-technology poster with clean urban motion, luminous energy accents, and polished feature marketing composition.

composition_elements.text:
TOYOTA
PHANH TAI SINH
TAI TAO NANG LUONG, TOI UU VAN HANH
Move your world
items: Top Left: White Toyota logo on flat blue sky.
Top Center: Cyan gradient headline bar 'PHANH TAI SINH' with large white subheadline 'TAI TAO NANG LUONG, TOI UU VAN HANH'.
Bottom Left: Speed-bump lane markings in black and yellow under the front half of the car.
Bottom Right: Handwritten white 'Move your world'.
Center/Background: Red Corolla Cross in front three-quarter view, soft city skyline, roadside greenery blur, and glowing wheel accents.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Bright clean daylight with hybrid-tech glow
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Commercial daylight, subtle motion blur, cyan energy aura at the wheels, glossy red paint reflections, clean urban atmosphere.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Toyota regenerative braking. Centerpiece is a red Toyota Corolla Cross crossing yellow-and-black speed bumps on a city road, with cyan glowing wheel accents suggesting energy recovery. Background is a bright urban skyline with slight roadside motion blur. Surrounding elements: headline 'PHANH TAI SINH', subheadline 'TAI TAO NANG LUONG, TOI UU VAN HANH', Toyota logo at top left, and handwritten 'Move your world' at bottom right. Technical style: photorealistic hybrid-feature automotive poster, bright clean daylight with hybrid-tech glow, subtle motion blur, glossy reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The speed bumps are important because they justify the braking-energy story. Keep the scene clean and controlled, with the vehicle stable and the wheel glow used as a restrained explanatory effect rather than a sci-fi exaggeration.
